name: Star Battle
tagline: Friends who open your link fly extra ships in the same sky.
description:
Send the invite and extra ships appear in the same sky, each person flying their own. Everyone is shooting the same wave.

You fly a little yellow ship across a field of stars. Red saucers come in from the right. Rocks take two hits. Friends look like you — do not shoot them. Fuel leaks away one point a second; catch a falling bottle or the run is over.

On a phone the stick is under your left thumb and fire is under your right — hold fire to keep shooting. On a computer it is W A S D and the space bar, the way it always was. P pauses. M mutes.

An unofficial port of Star Battle by gd4Ark, MIT-licensed. This copy adds the extra ships over a meeting.
